technique_name: Describe the different aspects of a programming language.
description: A programming language is composed of several components which together make up a complete language. These components include elements such as syntax, data types, variables, expressions, loops, control structures, functions, classes, libraries, and frameworks. Syntax refers to the set of rules that govern how the programming language is written and structured. Data types provide the structure for the data being used in the program.
